content:
I can’t determine the most likely next items from only the information that item 2047 was purchased. That requires transaction co-occurrence or recommendation model data for the grocery retailer.

If you provide the purchase history or item-association data, I can calculate the top 10 item IDs.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 2047. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
